verdict.rationale: Chroma's docs describe in-database full-text search using the $contains/$not_contains and $regex/$not_regex operators, and these can be combined with metadata filtering in .get and .query. The product site also advertises built-in lexical search via sparse vectors (BM25, SPLADE). A community user independently confirms the built-in regex and trigram search, so no separate search engine is needed. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of ranked BM25/SPLADE keyword scoring (only a homepage tagline), evidence that $contains results are relevance-ranked rather than plain substring filters, and hands-on corroboration of lexical ranking quality.
